card.name: Dose words in drug interaction advice
card.fires_on: The word dose (or doses, or the word the before dose) in drug-interaction sentences about adjusting, lowering or co-administering a medicine. Also fires on a few other partway-through spots, such as inside gabapentin.

modes.label: Dose adjustment wording
modes.description: The word dose or the word before it, in advice to adjust or reduce a dose when drugs are combined.
modes.example: If used together, monitor patients more frequently for adverse reactions and consider<< dose>> reduction of these drugs.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: Partway through a drug name in an interaction sentence.
modes.example: Morphine pharmacokinetic parameter values were not affected by administration of Gab<<ap>>entin 2 hours after morphine.
